title: 港股午盘(7/16)：恒指涨1.93%至25157，科技指数涨3.08%，小米快手各涨超6%
summary: 7月16日午盘，恒生指数涨1.93%报25157.56，恒生科技指数涨3.08%。小米、快手各涨超6%，美团、哔哩哔哩涨超5%，小鹏汽车涨超7%。黄金股走强，澜起科技跌超17%。
why: 港股科技/汽车全线拉升，持仓美团/小米今日走强；连续4日上涨累计逾2.6%，空头期权安全垫持续增厚。

title: 港股收评(7/15)：恒指涨1.46%至24695，AI应用股普涨，MINIMAX涨超13%，医药股强势
summary: 7月15日港股，恒生指数收涨1.46%报24695.62，恒生科技指数涨1.39%。MiniMax涨超14%，君实生物涨超10%，中金公司涨超4%。AI应用与生物医药双线领涨。
why: 昨日港股收盘强势，为今日继续高开提供基础；医药/AI双驱动说明市场轮动健康，对持仓整体有利。

title: Fed July 29 rate hike odds surge to 46.5%; new Chair Warsh says inflation 'still too high'
summary: CME FedWatch now prices a 46.5% probability of a 25bp hike at the July 29 FOMC meeting (from near-zero odds one month ago). Fed funds rate currently 3.50–3.75%, unchanged for four consecutive meetings. Chair Kevin Warsh emphasized inflation 'remains too high' without signaling direction.
why: 7月29日FOMC加息概率飙升至46.5%，若加息落地将压制估值并抬升implied vol；sell put策略需关注7月底前隐含波动率上升风险，考虑适当收窄行权价。

title: 证券时报：美财长Bessent称中国将接受恢复Section 301关税税率，中国6月出口创2021年来最快增速
summary: 美国财政部长Bessent暗示中国将接受恢复Section 301关税税率，市场解读为中美贸易实质性缓和信号。中国6月出口同比创2021年以来最快增速，主因AI设备需求爆发与关税抢运效应叠加。
why: 贸易摩擦缓和是港股/A股最大宏观催化剂；若301关税框架7月底前落地，科技/消费板块有望迎来估值重估，直接利好多数持仓。

title: 四大证券报7/16头条：长鑫科技科创板IPO开申购（募资579-666亿），创新药授权上半年1100亿美元历史新高，央行加大逆周期调节
summary: 7月16日要闻：①长鑫科技（DRAM国产替代）科创板IPO开启，发行价8.66元，募资约579-666亿元；②上半年创新药对外授权交易总额约1100亿美元，创历史纪录；③央行副行长邹澜表态加大逆周期调节；④A股1692家公司中731家（43.2%）中报业绩预喜。
why: 长鑫科技IPO是A股半导体年度事件，与SK海力士/美光HBM主线共振；央行宽松+业绩预喜比例高，A股风险情绪偏多，间接支撑港股科技估值。
source: 中国证券报/上海证券报/证券时报/证券日报

title: 港股创新药/CXO板块全线爆发，成7月15日盘面新热点，接棒科技汽车
summary: 7月15日港股，恒生指数与国企指数均涨超1%。创新药、CXO（合同研究）板块强势领涨，成为市场新主线热点，君实生物涨超10%引领板块。
why: 港股医药板块资金轮动显现，若行情持续则科技+医药双轮驱动形成；关注创新药龙头IV走高对现有put策略的影响。

title: Shein clears CSRC approval for Hong Kong IPO; HK market up 4 straight sessions
summary: Shein received approval from China's securities regulator (CSRC) to proceed with its planned Hong Kong IPO, clearing a key regulatory hurdle. The Hang Seng has gained 640+ points (+2.6%) over four consecutive sessions heading into the week.
why: Shein港股IPO将是近年来最大规模消费科技上市，对港股市场流动性与情绪有积极支撑；需关注其定价是否抽水影响其他持仓。

title: China June exports surge at fastest pace since 2021; Hang Seng closes +0.5%, CSI 300 +2.15%
summary: China's June exports jumped at the fastest pace since 2021, driven by AI equipment demand and tariff front-loading. Hang Seng recovered from early losses to close +0.5% at 24,341 on July 14; mainland stocks +2.15% at 4,796.50.
why: 中国出口数据超预期显著改善港股情绪；AI硬件出口强劲利好科技/半导体产业链持仓，配合贸易谈判进展形成双重利好。

title: U.S. confirms Nvidia H200 AI chip exports to China begun; ~10 firms approved for up to 75,000 chips each
summary: Commerce Dept confirmed H200 exports to China are underway but described volume as 'trivial.' ~10 Chinese firms approved (Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance among them) for up to 75,000 chips each via Nvidia, Lenovo, or Foxconn. Total approved volume under 200,000 chips. A 25% tariff applies. Lawmakers pressing on 'Blackwell loophole.'
why: H200出口许可是中国AI基础设施的重要突破：直接利好英伟达短期订单，阿里/腾讯获批加速云AI投入，对两者HK持仓均为正面催化；关注NVDA期权IV走向。

title: Tencent WeChat AI agent 'Xiaowei' in active beta; Q3 2026 public launch targeted — Bloomberg review
summary: Bloomberg reviewed Xiaowei, Tencent's native AI agent inside WeChat. It handles voice/text prompts, online search, Moments summarization, and mini-program tasks (flights, taxis, food orders). Uses WeLM + DeepSeek models. Tencent also launched Hy3 AI model July 6 and executed a HK$501M share buyback.
why: 微信AI智能体落地是腾讯最重要AI变现路径，支撑CICC HK$666目标价逻辑；今日小米/科技股整体大涨背景下，腾讯AI催化剂持续发酵；sell put仓位安全。

title: Citi forecasts Alibaba Cloud Q1 FY2027 revenue +45% YoY; AI revenue triple-digit growth for 11th straight quarter
summary: Citi raised its Alibaba Cloud revenue forecast to RMB 48.4B for the upcoming quarter, citing accelerating AI cloud adoption. Alibaba Cloud holds higher China AI cloud market share than the next three competitors combined. AI-related revenue has grown triple digits for 11 consecutive quarters.
why: 阿里云AI增速持续超预期，H200获批配额落实后将进一步加速；BABA估值重估核心驱动，对BABA期权多头策略（sell put或long call spread）具参考意义。

title: Xiaomi officially launches SkyNomad EREV brand targeting Li Auto; July EV deliveries exceed 30,000
summary: Xiaomi launched SkyNomad (小米蓬程) as its EREV sub-brand on July 14, targeting Li Auto L-series and Huawei Aito. First model is a 5.3m+ SUV with 1,500km+ combined range and pop-up roof camping edition. Total July EV deliveries (SU7+YU7) exceed 30,000; cumulative YU7 deliveries reached 258,232 since June 2025 launch.
why: 小米汽车7月突破3万辆/月交付门槛，SkyNomad新增程品牌将估值空间进一步打开；今日小米股价涨超6%是市场用脚投票；sell put安全垫充足。

title: Pop Mart THE MONSTERS 10th Anniversary NYC exhibition opens July 17; first US stop of global tour
summary: Pop Mart's 'THE MONSTERS 10th Anniversary World Tour' opens in New York City on July 17, 2026 at 423 W. 14th St. through August 31. First US stop following Shanghai, Taipei, HK, Paris, and Tokyo. Features immersive installations and exclusive merchandise. Tickets $10–$20.
why: Labubu纽约首展明日开幕，是品牌打入北美核心消费市场的里程碑性软新闻；可监测排队热度、一手价vs二手溢价，判断IP是否重新升温。

title: Billionaire Duan Yongping raises Pop Mart stake to 7.65% (102M shares) — third increase — countering 'Labubu fatigue'
summary: Chinese-American billionaire Duan Yongping raised his Pop Mart stake from 6.85% to 7.65% on July 6, his third increase. The move comes despite softer Labubu Hair Salon series reception and 'Labubu fatigue' concerns. Pop Mart stock had fallen ~40% from its August 2025 peak.
why: 段永平第三次增仓形成大资金背书信号；配合NYC首展明日开幕，IP耐久性争论有望趋向乐观；若展会反响好，泡泡玛特有望形成催化共振。

title: Tesla launches unsupervised Robotaxi in Miami — most challenging camera-only FSD test yet in tropical rain
summary: Tesla launched unsupervised Robotaxi service in Miami (western Miami-Dade) using camera-only FSD Model Y vehicles, its first market outside Texas/California. Miami's tropical downpours are the most challenging environment yet for camera-only FSD. ~59 vehicles previously operated across Austin, Dallas, Houston. Tesla Cybercab (no pedals/steering wheel) expected to join fleet late 2026.
why: Robotaxi迈阿密扩张是FSD商业化关键里程碑，热带降雨测试结果将影响市场对TSLA估值叙事的判断；对TSLA期权IV有直接影响，关注用户反馈与事故报告。

title: Google Gemini 3.5 Pro launches tomorrow (July 17) after full architectural rebuild; Alphabet Q2 earnings July 22
summary: Google DeepMind rebuilt Gemini 3.5 Pro from scratch after scrapping 2.5 Pro architecture due to failures in recursive tool-calling and SVG generation. New architecture targets 2M-token context and Deep Think Reasoning. Competing against OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol and Grok 4.5 (both launched July 9). Alphabet Q2 earnings due July 22.
why: Gemini 3.5 Pro明日发布+财报下周，形成双重催化窗口；若AI能力获认可，GOOGL财报前IV将上升，可考虑财报前sell straddle或short strangle策略。

title: Circle granted OCC federal trust bank charter; USDC reserves held directly; shares surge ~14%
summary: The OCC granted Circle approval to establish Circle National Trust, a federally chartered trust bank. This allows Circle to directly hold cash and Treasuries backing USDC ($73B+ circulation), eliminating reliance on third-party banks. Shares surged approximately 14% on the news.
why: Circle获联邦信托银行牌照是USDC史上最重要监管里程碑，直接消除储备风险；配合7月18日GENIUS Act截止日，稳定币监管框架加速成型，CRCL仓位受益。

title: Circle faces July 18 GENIUS Act implementation deadline; CRCL near $63 with key support at $61.70
summary: The GENIUS Act's one-year implementation deadline falls July 18, 2026, requiring six federal agencies to finalize stablecoin rules. CRCL near $63 with key support at $61.70; analysts see downside risk toward $49 if agencies impose strict capital/reserve standards.
why: 后天（7/18）GENIUS Act截止是Circle最重要近期事件驱动；监管细则若友好，CRCL有望上冲；若过严则下压稳定币生态，需紧密跟踪各机构指引发布。

title: SK Hynix soars 13% on Nasdaq debut with record $26.5B foreign listing; full-year 2026 HBM4 supply already sold out
summary: SK Hynix raised $26.5B in the largest-ever US listing by a foreign company (July 10), opening at $170 vs $149 issue price (+14%), closing +13%. Market cap hit $1.25 trillion. HBM4 supply for all of CY2026 is sold out. Company is now moderating HBM4 ramp to redirect capacity toward higher-margin conventional DRAM.
why: SK海力士美股上市是HBM超级周期的「机构确认」事件；HBM4全年售罄+DRAM资源倾斜，证明存储周期延续，对美光/闪迪持仓均为强力正面验证。

title: DigiTimes：HBM4价格预计2027年翻倍至4-5美元/GB，SK海力士CEO称2027年存储供应最短缺
summary: DigiTimes报告，受AI算力需求爆发和产能结构性瓶颈影响，HBM4价格预计2027年翻倍，从当前约2美元/GB升至4-5美元/GB。SK海力士CEO表示2027年将是存储芯片供应短缺最严重的一年，需求将持续超过产能直至2030年后。
why: HBM4涨价预期强化了美光/SK海力士/闪迪长期多头逻辑；对美光（MU）和闪迪（SNDK）持仓额外增加估值支撑，期权策略可考虑拉长到期日。

title: Intel 18A-P enters risk production; AMD, Nvidia, OpenAI confirmed as design wins; EMIB yields 98%; Q2 earnings July 23
summary: Intel 18A-P entered risk production July 15, delivering 9% higher performance at iso-power vs 18A. Yields improved from 65% to 85% (TSMC N2 at ~90%). AMD, Nvidia, Microsoft, OpenAI, and AWS confirmed as design wins on 18A/14A nodes. EMIB advanced packaging reaches 98% yields. HSBC doubled price target to $200. Q2 earnings due July 23.
why: 英特尔代工业务重大突破：英伟达/AMD/OpenAI全确认合作，18A良率逼近TSMC，HSBC目标价翻倍；Q2财报下周即验证，期权IV将上升，财报前后注意仓位调整。

title: Micron: AI memory demand drives record results and long-term HBM contracts; 2026 HBM capacity fully sold out
summary: Micron's recent quarterly results set records driven by AI memory demand. HBM capacity for all of CY2026 is sold out. HBM4 shipments for Nvidia Vera Rubin are ramping at 2x the pace of HBM3E. 16 Strategic Customer Agreements with take-or-pay terms signed. HBM TAM projected to exceed $100B by 2027. Stock recovered +4.24% on July 14.
why: 美光HBM产能全年售罄+take-or-pay长约，提供极强下行保护；HBM4加速量产是下半年最重要的催化剂之一，sell put仓位安全垫充足。

title: SanDisk retests $1,500 support on NAND competition fears; Goldman Sachs raises target to $2,200
summary: SanDisk (SNDK) fell below $1,500 on July 15 amid fears of NAND pricing weakness, rising YMTC competition, and capacity expansion margin pressure. The stock surged ~800% in H1 2026. Goldman Sachs raised its price target to $2,200 from $1,200 (Buy), citing enterprise SSD demand and tighter supply.
why: 闪迪$1500支撑位测试是近期关键技术节点；高盛目标价$2200显示40%+上行空间，但800%的H1涨幅带来高波动风险；关注NAND现货价格走向以决定期权策略方向。

title: SanDisk secures multi-year NAND supply deal with Meta for AI infrastructure; Kioxia rival eyes Nasdaq IPO
summary: SanDisk secured a multi-year NAND supply agreement with Meta Platforms as a key AI infrastructure supplier from 2026 onward. With Kioxia, began 10th-gen 3D NAND production at Kitakami Fab2 in Japan. Kioxia (manufacturing partner and NAND rival) is also preparing a US Nasdaq listing.
why: Meta AI基础设施NAND长约锁定闪迪2026+基础出货量；但Kioxia上市若成功将改变NAND竞争格局，需跟踪其定价策略对闪迪溢价的影响。

title: Costco June net sales +10.6% to $29.24B; comps +8.8%; digital sales +20.9%; declares $1.47/share quarterly dividend
summary: Costco net sales for 5-week period ended July 5, 2026 rose 10.6% YoY to $29.24B. Comparable sales +8.8% (US +10.6%); digital sales +20.9%. Quarterly dividend of $1.47/share declared, payable August 7. Sales growth decelerated from May's +12.5%, sending shares down 1.2% after-hours.
why: 好市多月度销售强劲但略有减速，数字增长亮眼；持续股息派发是sell put策略核心配置逻辑验证，关注减速趋势是否持续影响全年指引。

title: 携程遭监管双重夹击：网信办罚款千万（数据出境），反垄断调查已满五个月；Citi目标价下调至$64
summary: 2026年6月，上海市网信办对携程开出千万元罚单（数据出境违规），反垄断调查持续进行已满五个月，涉及数据合规、反垄断、算法治理、票务规范四条监管线。Citi将TCOM目标价从$82下调至$64，Barclays调至$60，Q2增速指引仅3%-8%。
why: 携程监管压力多线汇聚+增速指引偏低，短期不确定性显著；对TCOM期权策略需适当提高sell put行权价安全距离，避免监管重锤导致踩踏。

title: 老铺黄金一年股价暴跌64%，市值蒸发约1200亿港元；高库存+金价回调+竞争加剧三重压力
summary: 老铺黄金从2025年7月高点1065港元跌至约380港元，市值蒸发约1200亿港元。存货从40.88亿元飙升至160.4亿元，公司在高位大举囤金。周大福古法金系列上半年销售额34亿港元（+48%）竞争加剧。近期特别股息已于7月8日派发。
why: 老铺黄金金价敞口过大，若金价继续调整将持续承压；竞争加剧削弱护城河，需重新评估金价走势支撑仓位逻辑；特别股息是近期唯一正面事件。

title: 蜜雪冰城股价年内跌近50%，香港门店从9家缩至5家，出海扩张主动换挡
summary: 蜜雪冰城(2097.HK)股价年内跌近50%，7月低触208港元，市值缩水近千亿港元。香港门店从巅峰9家收缩至5家，公司将资源从开新店转向存量门店精细化运营。新茶饮行业整体进入增速换挡期。
why: 蜜雪冰城出海放缓是新茶饮行业竞争饱和的缩影；股价持续探底，sell put需保持较宽安全距离，关注何时出现企稳信号（如同店销售改善）。

title: Interactive Brokers Q2 2026 earnings July 21; adds 12 crypto tokens including USDC/PYUSD stablecoin wallet transfers
summary: IBKR announces Q2 2026 results July 21 after market close. Expanded crypto: 9 tokens via Zerohash, 3 via Paxos (July 14). Now supports bidirectional USDC, PYUSD, RLUSD wallet deposits/withdrawals. Analysts expect double-digit EPS growth driven by higher trading volumes.
why: 盈透证券Q2财报下周五公布，加密+稳定币扩张是差异化看点；若市场交易量高位维持，佣金收入有望超预期；财报前IV上升提供卖期权机会。

title: Palantir selected for US Army NGC2 data modernization; US Government revenue +84% YoY to $687M in Q1 2026
summary: The US Army selected Palantir Foundry as the core cloud data layer for its NGC2 modernization program, shifting from prototype to wide deployment. US Government revenue surged 84% to $687M in Q1 2026; RPO +134% YoY. Palantir-Nvidia partnership enables sovereign AI environments for classified US government settings.
why: 美军NGC2合同将Palantir推上「国防AI基础设施」地位，政府收入84%增速显示极强护城河；若持仓PLTR，此消息强化长期多头逻辑。

title: 拼多多2025年净利润首次同比下降12%，Temu受de minimis取消重挫；2026年GMV目标1300亿美元
summary: 拼多多2025年净利润首次下降（同比约-12%），主因Temu在美国de minimis豁免取消后物流成本飙升，欧盟7月起取消150欧元免税带来新一轮压力。2026年GMV目标1300亿美元（+50%）。PDD另创设新品牌部门「新拼木」，首期投资150亿元，三年规划1000亿元。
why: 拼多多净利下降打破持续增长神话；Temu成本结构挑战持续，对PDD期权策略需保守对待下行风险，同时新拼木品牌战略是否能打开新增长空间值得持续跟踪。
